reviews.review:
The concept is good: a war-conquest game with simple politics, economics, recruiting/training, and diplomacy, like an improved digital version of RISK. However, I cannot recommend this game because it is unfinished and heavily bugged, and it has remained as such for months. 

The game remains unplayable when you have already conquered half of the world, what becomes very frustrating after weeks of working your way up towards total dominance, with movement vectors disappearing (losing track of your troops in movement), troops simply vanishing without further information of what happened, icons overlapping and being deformed (impossible to determine what you have built), islands on the map that are occupied by the enemy but not "conquerable" because there is no way to deploy your troops over there (click on that island)... The list is endless.

There is no tutorial, you need to figure out everything. Sometimes you get nuked and have no idea of "who" of your enemies did it (to reply) because there is no information. Some concepts like "infrastructure budget" are not explained, so you don't know the effects of investing more or less. You program dozens of battles before passing your turn and would like to review the outcome of each of them, well, the information (casualties) remains available only for a few seconds; how are you supposed to supervise all scenarios in which you are involved in seconds? There are a couple of locations (Pacific Ocean) and Caribbean that if you place your troops there, they will be stuck for the rest of the game with no option to disband. If you build ships (normally by accident) on a lake or a river that has no exit to the sea, they will be stuck there forever with no option to "dissolve" (dismantle) consuming resources for the rest of the game.

The game needs a lot of work, and this is not one of those "advanced" complicated games like Paradox games... I have been communicating with the devs for months, informing them of all these issues and sending them suggestions but they have failing in correcting them.

Another game that goes to waste,
